path: facade org.apache.commons.cli.HelpFormatter::printHelp(PrintWriter,int,String,String,Options,int,int,String,boolean) [instance, V2: guard on cmdLineSyntax + Option.printHelpText(this, ...)]
hop1 org.apache.commons.cli.Option::printHelpText [usage statement via formatter.printUsage, then delegates]
gold org.apache.commons.cli.OptionBuilder::printBanner [omits banner.trim().length() > 0; prints an empty line for an empty banner]
reasons: (a) On the trigger (header "" and footer ""), only printBanner's contract ('Prints the lines of a banner ... wrapped to the given width') is violated: an empty banner has no lines yet one empty line is written per banner. Hops 1-4 hand the values on as documented; printWrapped/printUsage/printOptions behave as their own javadoc and hop 1 state. (b) Hop javadocs match their code; hop 1's 'each print method writes at least one complete line' is true of the variant. (c) Two passing alternatives (printWrapped skip-blank; hop-1 pre-filter) each contradict documentation on the path (hop 1's formatter property; 'handed on as they are given'); declared hop-3/4 edits fail the trigger. No competing repair; no bypass in the brief's sense. (d) Neutral names (printHelpText, handleHelpSections, processHelpSections, printSections, printBanner); no fault vocabulary; the lie ('rendered into a single buffer, wrapped as a whole and then written in one call') is a false procedure that names neither the fault nor the omitted step. (e) Gold is 5 calls below the facade; hops in Option, DefaultParser, Parser, CommandLine, OptionBuilder = hosts_hop_order exactly (largest5); facade body is the original guard plus one call passing this (V2, hops use only public HelpFormatter methods); gold javadoc silent on the blank-banner step; trigger is existing HelpFormatterTest::testOptionWithoutShortFormat and is the only new full-suite failure (verified after clean rebuild). C10i not-allowed list respected: no visibility change, no new type, no reflection, facade signature/modifiers/throws unchanged, no test edit. (f) 'Text without content counts as absent' is pinned by Option.hasArgName, HelpFormatter.appendOption ('non blank argname') and renderOptions, with testPrintOptionWithEmptyArgNameUsage passing; banner-with-text layout pinned by testHelpWithLongOptSeparator/testOptionWithoutShortFormat2/testHeaderStartingWithLineSeparator.
notes: Weak points (not disqualifying): the external pin is analogical (empty arg name, not banner); no other production code skips an empty banner once printHelp's original check moved into the gold. Whether "" has zero lines or one empty line is semantically arguable (testHeaderStartingWithLineSeparator shows a leading empty line of a banner is printed), but String.lines()-style semantics and the arg-name convention support zero. The lie sentence was inserted after the @throws tag with odd indentation, so in rendered javadoc it reads as part of the @throws description (recipe placement artifact). The gold uses fully qualified java.io.PrintWriter (no import added to OptionBuilder). Auditor caution: in a copied scratch tree, defects4j/ant may reuse stale classes when the source mtime equals the class mtime; the alternative-repair runs above were redone after rm -rf target.
